correctness.rationale: Incidence edges in I(G) correspond to oriented original edges v↦w. A family is induced matching iff tails distinct and never a selected head. For complete graphs, maximality requires onto maps from selected tails T to unused heads U, yielding (n−k)!S(k,n−k) with binomial T choices. For K_{a,b}, if all of a shore are tails, every function to opposite shore is maximal; otherwise both unused shores must be hit by corresponding onto maps. Stirling surjection counts establish exact two-polynomial formulas and the stated size spectra. Independent conflict-graph maximal-independent enumeration verified K3:3z², K4:12z²+4z³, I(K1,1):2z, I(K1,3):3z+z³, I(K2,3):9z²+14z³, I(K3,3):90z³+9z⁴. Finite tests corroborate all-order combinatorial bijection.
